old_problem: The historical record retained Pending/BLOCKED because the Master Procedure and Criteria are TBD and clearing can destroy unread messages. IPMI section 22.3 authoritatively defines mandatory App command 0x30, its one-byte mask and completion response; section 22.4 defines Get Message Flags 0x31. The exact disposable test flag and evidence-preservation scope can be parameterized under ED-17 rather than guessed.
disposition_reason: Preserve the Master TBD history but allow only an isolated, owner-approved standard one-bit clear after immutable evidence capture. For bits 0/1, use only controlled disposable test messages whose sender/audit copies are already retained because the command flushes unread queue/buffer contents. For bit 3, clear only a pre-existing approved watchdog pre-timeout flag and never trigger a watchdog to manufacture coverage. OEM bits require vendor semantics; reserved bits stay zero. Verify exact 0x31 before/after and never retry an uncertain clear.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1005, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 1006 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 1006 / variant 4ce1f555063671d5.

IPMI v2.0 section 22.3 defines App command 0x30 with one mask byte: bit 0 flushes Receive Message Queue, bit 1 clears Event Message Buffer, bit 3 clears watchdog pre-timeout flag, bits 7:5 clear OEM flags and bits 4/2 are reserved.

Clearing bits 0/1 flushes unread data and clears the associated available/full flags. This is irreversible evidence mutation, so pre-captured controlled-source copies, one-bit scope and immediate approval are the safety contract; SEL/log wholesale clear is unrelated and forbidden.
Get Message Flags 0x31 supplies exact pre/post bit readback. An implementation need not error when clearing unsupported Event Message Buffer, so completion alone or a no-op cannot prove coverage.

ED-03, ED-15 through ED-19, especially ED-17, ED-24, ED-26 through ED-28 and ED-30 permit an approved evidence-preserving clear; ED-33 through ED-38 preserve TBD/OEM uncertainty and prohibit bulk clear, write substitution and retry.

test_case.test_name: Clear one approved standard BMC message flag after immutable evidence capture
test_case.purpose: Verify one selected standard message flag can be cleared on an isolated controlled fixture while all diagnostic content needed for audit is already preserved, unrelated standard/OEM flags remain unchanged and no SEL/log wholesale deletion occurs.
required_package: Immutable DUT/BMC/interface identity, pinned firmware/ipmitool/parser and protected App 0x30/0x31 raw runner

Versioned coverage matrix for standard bit 0 Receive Message Queue, bit 1 Event Message Buffer and bit 3 watchdog pre-timeout flag, with feature support, exact disposable fixture, owner and SPEC-backed N/A
Immutable pre-clear package: raw 0x31, SMS_ATN/interface state, timestamps, controlled message/event producer copies, related SEL/audit/log evidence and hash/retention proof
OEM/System Integrator definition and handler only if bits 7:5 are ever tested; otherwise OEM flags are never cleared, and reserved bits 4/2 remain zero
Independent OOB/console and message/queue health observer, immediate approval, no-retry rule and incident escalation for uncertain completion or unrelated data loss
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID MATRIX PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind the exact isolated target and select one approved flag. Require a controlled disposable fixture: externally retain the exact producer/audit copies for queue/buffer data, or for bit 3 use only an already-present approved watchdog flag; never create watchdog pre-timeout in this case. Preserve SEL, logs and full raw 0x31 baseline. Construct a one-bit `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x30 <mask>` with reserved bits zero and OEM bits zero unless vendor-defined. Immediately before the irreversible clear, show the exact flag/data loss and obtain confirmation. Send once and capture completion; never retry if uncertain. Read 0x31 and require only the selected flag cleared with all unrelated standard/OEM flags unchanged; compare queue/buffer/interface health and retained evidence. Do not clear SEL/logs, use a multi-bit/all-flags mask, drain via alternate commands as substitution, or generate events/watchdog actions automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The selected supported flag is proven set before action, all disposable content is independently retained, one approved 0x30 clear completes, and 0x31 shows only that flag cleared. Unrelated standard/OEM flags, SEL/audit/log evidence, BMC health and message interfaces remain intact. Unsupported/no-op behavior is not PASS, and no action is repeated.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/single flag, immutable pre-evidence, immediate approval, one exact mask, completion 00, pre-set to post-clear 0x31 transition, unchanged unrelated bits and intact retained evidence/health. Command success, clearing an already-zero flag, unsupported Event Buffer silent acceptance, multi-bit/OEM/reserved mask, missing producer copies, SEL/log deletion, unexpected data loss or retry cannot pass. Missing controlled fixture/scope is NOT READY rather than Pending.
safety_gate: Require point-of-action confirmation after showing raw 0x31, exact one-bit mask, unread data that will be flushed, immutable copies and unrelated flags that must remain.
Use only controlled disposable test messages/events in an isolated scope; never flush production, incident or unexplained unread data.
Never clear OEM bits without vendor semantics/handler approval and never set reserved bits 4 or 2.
Do not execute the generic source log clear; preserve SEL, audit, event and producer evidence before any irreversible clear per ED-17.
Do not trigger watchdog pre-timeout, RAS, reset or message flood to create a flag in this case; fixture creation is separately approved.
No automatic retry after timeout or uncertain completion. Re-read once only under the pre-approved verification step and escalate discrepancies.
expected_evidence: Master TBD snapshot, standard flag map, exact target/firmware/tool/parser and Project fixture-matrix revision
Pre-clear raw 0x31, decoded full flag byte, SMS_ATN/interface state and immutable controlled producer/audit/SEL/log package with hashes
Immediate approval, exact one-bit 0x30 request, completion/framing and no-retry audit
Post-clear raw 0x31 proving selected transition and unchanged unrelated/OEM bits plus queue/buffer/interface health
Explicit irreversible-data disposition, preserved evidence locations and independent engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Cleared unread data cannot be restored; safety depends on controlled disposable fixtures and immutable pre-capture. On uncertain completion or unexpected flag/data loss, stop all clears, preserve remaining flags/logs/interfaces and escalate through the BMC/incident process. Do not recreate evidence, clear more data, reset/power the system or retry to make the result appear consistent.

source_conflict.reason: The protected Master remains TBD, but the exact named mandatory operation has a complete standard command/bit/readback contract. A Project-controlled disposable fixture and single-bit scope provide acceptance without guessing OEM flags or using the generic log clear.

blocked.reason: Core standard clear semantics and verification are defined. Exact existing flag, disposable evidence scope, feature support and approval are finite Project prerequisites under the explicit irreversible-data safety gate.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: DUT/BMC/interface binding; pinned 0x30/0x31 tooling; standard-bit support/coverage matrix; controlled disposable fixture and immutable producer/audit copies; OEM mapping if ever applicable; immediate approval and incident plan.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER HYBRID CASE ONLY; MASTER TBD PRESERVED; NO MESSAGE FLAG, QUEUE, BUFFER, WATCHDOG, SEL, LOG, IPMI, RESET, POWER OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Sections 22.3/22.4, Tables 22-4/22-5 and Appendix G define mandatory App 0x30/0x31, flush/clear effects, standard/OEM/reserved flag bits and unsupported Event Buffer no-error behavior.

project_authority: The Project BMC/incident owner selects an existing controlled standard flag, proves its unread content is disposable and independently retained, and approves the irreversible one-shot clear. OEM flags require OEM authority; no Project choice can make missing pre-evidence recoverable after the fact.
